description: Election Commission - D. L. S. S. Chandrasiri was selected as the member of the Rathnapura M/C
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government council (Rathnapura Municipal Council) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It specifically deals with the electoral process for local authorities, including the nomination and declaration of a new council member to fill a seat that became vacant. This content falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local government elections.
